ttf_role: species-disjoint transferability of prospectively frozen transition/predictor spaces

predictor_spaces.RC: same R plus typed-connectivity edge feature space C

transition_lane.target: prospectively defined within-species transition/turnover edge response
transition_lane.train_eval_rule: TTF species-disjoint split frozen before evaluation-species outcomes fit any shared field
transition_lane.self_diagnostic: required if a qualified non-transfer result is interpreted as system/lineage-conditioned

forbidden: select species because within-species C-minus-R was favorable
select species because a Structural model reached significance
drop evaluation species because TTF score is inconvenient
tune C on held-out evaluation-species outcomes

feature_validity: or C fit on TTF training species only
or C cross-fitted with each evaluation species excluded

interpretation.self_detectable_and_transfer_supported: candidate reusable state-transition field within tested domain
interpretation.self_detectable_and_transfer_not_detecte: system/lineage-conditioned transition structure within tested domain
interpretation.ttf_transfer_without_structural_adequacy: valid only at TTF predictive level; cannot rescue failed within-system adequacy

current_boundaries.genetic_TTF_result: empirical example of within-species detectability without detectable cross-species transfer
